scripts.title: cfb — create feature branch (placeholder)
scripts.description: Placeholder. Will create a feature branch from the current base branch. Usage: cfb <branch-name>

scripts.title: clean — strip bin/obj from a .NET repo
scripts.description: Recursively deletes bin/ and obj/ folders next to a .sln/.csproj. -d also removes .vscode/, -b runs dotnet restore + build afterwards.

scripts.title: del-branch-after-pr — delete branch after PR merged (placeholder)
scripts.description: Placeholder. Will delete a local branch after its PR has been merged. Usage: del-branch-after-pr [branch-name]

scripts.title: findf — find file by name (case-insensitive)
scripts.description: Wraps `find . -iname '*<term>*'` and prints the command before running it.

scripts.title: gss — interactive git fast-forward
scripts.description: Fetches, reports commits behind, optionally stashes local changes, fast-forwards, and re-applies the stash. Detects diverged branches and bails out cleanly.

scripts.title: jwt_decode — pretty-print a JWT from stdin
scripts.description: Reads a JWT on stdin, base64url-decodes the header and payload, and pipes both through jq. Requires jq.

scripts.title: myip — print public IP
scripts.description: Curls ifconfig.me and prints the resolved public IP address.

scripts.title: nu — upgrade NuGet package references
scripts.description: Walks every *.*proj file and runs `dotnet add package <name>` for each PackageReference whose version is not a pre-release.

scripts.title: search — recursive grep (skips dll/zip/js/css)
scripts.description: Case-insensitive recursive grep with line numbers, excluding common binary and front-end build artefacts.

scripts.title: search_word — highlighted in-file search
scripts.description: Awk-based search that prints matching lines with the pattern highlighted in red and prefixed by line number. Usage: search_word <pattern> <file>

scripts.title: watch — poor-man's watch(1)
scripts.description: Re-runs the supplied command every second on a cleared screen. Stand-in for `watch` on systems that don't ship it.
